nonGoals: Redoing accepted milestones M1-M15, M17-M20, M22, M23a-M23f.
mise run verify, browser/Chromium/Vite tests, the whole native parity suite, cargo test --workspace, cargo test -p nodetto-native (deferred and NOT yet run).
cad3d M21 and M18; cad3d design or plan edits; README.md, impl-plans/README.md, mise.toml edits.
Any write under the repository tmp/; any server, auth, secret or deployment content.
constraints: Workers edit only their writePaths; progress goes to their own plan file. No git state changes, no stash, branches or worktrees; never push.
English only, no emojis, strict TypeScript; cargo with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true and CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/capture-m16.
artifactRoots exactly ["target"]; native-parity/capture.test.ts and mcp-stdio.test.ts excluded and deferred.
CLI unit tests run with UPDATE_CAPTURE_FIXTURES=0; tracked fixtures unchanged.
No test, deadline or budget relaxed; timing tests up to three attempts, then alone, all logged.
Per-edit fresh reads and git hash-object before and after each owned file; drift is recorded, not overwritten.
